label: complete MVP pipeline: perception, fusion, retrieval, reasoning, safety, decision support, automated reporting

perception.lung: EfficientNet-B0 multi-label, 4 findings, Platt per finding

components.reasoning: HuatuoGPT-o1-8B Q4_K_M via llama.cpp, temperature 0, fixed seed, max_revisions=1
components.retrieval: TF-IDF over the corpus, relevance floor 0.10
components.decision_support: deterministic: severity, alerts, examinations, scenario routing
components.reporting: structured report, templated conclusion, archive with content hash

verification.reasoning_ab: models/clinical_reasoning_v4_final/ -- 0 errors and 0/5 withheld without retrieval, on five synthetic cases

what_this_establishes: The complete MVP pipeline is implemented and technically verified. The system provides multimodal POCUS-based decision support with deterministic safety controls, retrieval-augmented reasoning, structured recommendations and automated reporting.
what_this_does_not_establish: Clinical validation against expert ground truth remains outside the current internship scope. No figure in this project was measured against a patient outcome or against a clinician's conclusion. The benchmarks are software tests on synthetic cases; they establish that the safety mechanisms behave as specified and say nothing about diagnostic accuracy.
known_limitations: Therapeutic considerations cover undifferentiated shock only. One protocol is sourced (Hasanin et al. 2024, CC BY 4.0); the other three priority presentations return no consideration rather than generating one, which is the designed behaviour.
Alert thresholds are conventional warning bounds, not a validated scoring system. An alert means a configured limit was crossed and nothing more.

Severity is monotone and the benchmark cases are all difficult, so nine of ten score HIGH. A benign control is included in the regression precisely because a suite of hard cases cannot show that the rule discriminates.
Case counts are small: 165 lung, 199 gallbladder, 100 cardiac validation patients.
Only the triage model was evaluated across independent sources (0.617 to 0.789).
The per-organ inference functions live in notebooks, so no test imports them; the suite proves the contract is enforced, not that the ultrasound agent honours it.
Retrieval showed no measurable benefit on the five-case benchmark and remains inconclusive.
